title: Test a Decision Before Announcing It
use: You want to challenge a proposed change before asking the team.
output: A grounded challenge brief and consultation questions.
prompt: We want to require AI-written self-reviews next quarter. Test that proposal and help me ask the team what we might be missing.

title: Put a Concern Into Words
use: You know something needs raising but struggle to express it.
output: A clear concern, a concrete request, and a suitable route.
prompt: English is my second language. I think our promotion criteria overlook support work. Help me put the concern into words.

title: Rehearse Speaking Up
use: You want to practise questioning someone with more authority.
output: A short role-play, practical feedback, and a revised opening.
prompt: Help me practise telling the founder that the new delivery deadline is unrealistic.

title: Make Room for Challenge
use: You want input before a decision becomes final.
output: An invitation, participation options, and a response commitment.
prompt: We are changing how project leads collect performance feedback. Help me hear different views before we decide.

title: Respond When AI Carries the Concern
use: A concern arrives through an AI-assisted or unattributed document.
output: An evidence note, response draft, and follow-up step.
prompt: Someone shared an AI-generated critique of our new review process without a name. Help me respond and decide what to check.

title: Show What Happened Next
use: People have raised a concern and need an honest update.
output: A response-and-action note with commitments to confirm.
prompt: We agreed to clarify how mentoring counts as promotion evidence. Help me explain what will change and track the follow-through.
